_about: Instrumental music beds generated with ACE-Step 1.5 (MIT licence, commercial use allowed; github.com/ace-step/ACE-Step-1.5). Replaces the repetitive second-half bed (Michael 2026-11-14). Outputs go to the PRIVATE studio release music-candidates, never this repo. Batch 2 (Michael 2026-11-14: batch 1 too basic; tracks should work on both channels, the nostalgia channel and this one): warmer, real-instrument, versatile.
